text:
Peverell Semiconductors laid off 310 staff, the company announced on 14 March 2025.

Chief Executive Officer Marguerite Idowu-Hale confirmed the cuts. The job losses represent roughly 8% of the company's 3,875-person workforce.

The figure appears in a restructuring notice Peverell filed with the Northmarch Securities Registry. I read the notice, and the same number was read out on the company's first-quarter earnings call, which I listened to as it was held.

Ms Idowu-Hale confirmed the reduction on that call. The notice and the call gave the same total, 310, with no difference between them.

Peverell is among the larger employers in the Baywater area, and the announcement will be felt by many households here. This paper will continue to report on how the cuts affect workers and the wider community as further details become available.
